anti_claim: instrument-resolution measurement; NOT evidence about zeta or RH
VERDICT: RESOLVABLE — some height exits the matched-window GUE band; a genuine crossover to pursue frame-agnostic
sealed_prediction_outcome: FALSIFIED on both counts: predicted deviation ~1e-3 BELOW the floor (not resolvable) and, if resolvable, NEGATIVE sign. Measured: ~+1.2e-2 at gamma~5e3, ABOVE the floor (resolvable), POSITIVE sign (zeta <r~> approaches GUE from ABOVE). The data overrode the hypothesis.

unfolding_confound_falsifier.concern: the deviation is largest at low gamma, exactly where the R-vM asymptotic density is least accurate and the window spans the most density variation -> a density-gradient/unfolding artifact would give a positive r~ bias, same sign and location (the solar situation replayed).
unfolding_confound_falsifier.test: re-compute <r~> on each block by R-vM asymptotic unfold, local empirical unfold_poly, and RAW (no unfold).
unfolding_confound_falsifier.result: all three AGREE to ~4 digits at every block (e.g. gamma~5e3: R-vM 0.61474, poly 0.61449, raw 0.61474). raw==unfolded confirms r~ is intrinsically unfolding-free here (smooth density does not bias the adjacent-gap ratio).
unfolding_confound_falsifier.verdict: CONFOUND EXCLUDED — the crossover is robust to unfold choice; it is real zeta finite-height behavior, not an unfolding/density-gradient artifact.

reading: RESOLVABLE finite-height crossover, confound-excluded. zeta <r~> decreases monotonically from ~0.615 (gamma~5e3) to ~0.603 = GUE (gamma~1.1e6), from ABOVE, consistent across W=2000/5000/10000, exceeding the finite-window GUE jitter floor at all but the highest gamma. §0 anti-claim MAINTAINED: this is an instrument-resolution result (the ARS <r~> classifier RESOLVES the known finite-height approach of zeta spacing statistics to GUE above its own noise floor) — calibration, NOT evidence about RH. Functional form left frame-agnostic: the deviation decreases toward 0 with height but the high-gamma point falls faster than linear-in-1/log, so no 1/log law is asserted (g-tilde frame NOT imposed).
null_caveat: the tridiagonal central-window GUE null mean (~0.600) sits ~0.002 below the true Atas 0.60266 (finite-W/edge); this makes the zeta deviation vs the null ~0.002 larger than vs true GUE, negligible against the ~1.2e-2 effect. At high gamma zeta (0.603) matches true GUE (0.6027) directly.
